Both are reconcilable (2 included + up to 2 additional at $24.50) but the wording differs between surfaces. Consider harmonising to prevent user confusion.
Dashboard uses moneyWhole for THIS QUARTER card ($3,718 / $6,682 · $2,964 left). This matches web behaviour; no change required, just noting the format choice is intentional.

The review-request bullet 'tapping a card opens /tool/mobile-parity-sweep' appears to be a copy-paste of the app subdomain slug — the actual (and correct) behaviour is /tool/{tool-slug} e.g. /tool/statement-decoder. Verified working. No fix required.
